lead.en: Compose a message and show a host-resolved link preview before sending.
lead.zh: 撰写消息，并在发送前展示由宿主解析的链接预览。

usageRust:
use kui::components::link_unfurl::LinkUnfurl;

let control = cx.new(|cx| LinkUnfurl::new("Message", window, cx));

rule.en: The component does not visit URLs. It emits Resolve, Cancel, Open and Send for the host to handle. Responses must match the request ID. A send failure preserves the draft; edits made while sending are not cleared by an older success.
rule.zh: 组件不会访问 URL。Resolve、Cancel、Open 和 Send 由宿主处理，响应必须匹配请求 ID。发送失败会保留草稿；发送期间新编辑的内容不会被旧请求的成功结果清空。

api.en: set_text updates the composer; resolve_preview returns a host-supplied preview or error; resolve_send confirms or fails sending. Images, when supplied, must be decoded RenderImage values. Removing a link or replacing it emits Cancel for its outstanding preview.
api.zh: set_text 更新文本；resolve_preview 返回宿主提供的预览或错误；resolve_send 确认发送或返回失败。图片须由宿主提供已解码的 RenderImage。移除或替换链接时会发出 Cancel。

motion.en: The card expands and collapses with a reduced-motion-aware transition; hidden previews do not request animation frames. Inline link morph, multiple link previews, Alt+Enter, drag-to-collapse, live announcements and real visual/accessibility acceptance remain pending.
motion.zh: 预览卡有支持减少动效的展开和收起过渡，隐藏时不请求动画帧。行内链接形变、多链接预览、Alt+Enter、拖动收起、状态播报及实际视觉和无障碍验收仍待完成。
